hooks.note: Main-view renderer labels the row prepared by the record builder. A late-install fallback creates a missing button with the native factory; it publishes a new row only after success.
APL_SET_Initial_menu_change_Entry_table: picks the key table (DAT_0016910c) for the selected entry; ours gets the payload's table.

Root record builder called by APL_SET_Initial_menu_View before the native window builder. Append System row after stock initializes and clears the record; update panel[0x1f] count. Map our selected item to System before stock builds its column. Complete six-byte CMP/IT/CMP prefix is relocated unchanged.

Stock recurring GTK UI callback: gtk_timeout_add(1000,0x1a21d,app) in FUN_0001ab70 before gtk_main. Run original first; return 0 means shutdown and no view access. Repair already-built System view on UI thread, retaining selection and skipping child/helper submenus.

bindings.note: FUN_000d78ec: fills the right column of the run-time record for a category or item id.
View structure of the main menu; word 4 = record, 5 = window, 0x20+i = right-column buttons.
Active key table pointer: {key, press, repeat, release, 0} records ending with 0xffffffff.
Number of right-column rows the renderer handles (set by FUN_000d7b80).
Key table of System items (Remote Control, Quick Start, Default Settings): up, down, OK, back.
FUN_000bea0c: makes right-column button s_<row>_btn in the main window (as FUN_000bf070 does for each row of the record).
Names of the right-column buttons s_1st_btn .. s_11th_btn.
Per-row button name the renderer looks up (set by FUN_000bf070 for the rows it made).
Per-row value-label name (rows with flag 2 only); 0 for ours.
Main category key table, selected by default in APL_SET_Initial_menu_change_Entry_table; distinguishes visible main-menu interaction from native child dialogs during tick repair.

variants.note: Every function used here has the 1.82 machine code instruction for instruction (renderer FUN_00096938, entry table FUN_0009aa28, view FUN_0009ad70, column builder FUN_000d798c, window builder FUN_000bf104, right-row button FUN_000beaa0, and what they call); code moved +0x38..+0xa0, data and strings +0xb8 (paired from their movw/movt loads). The System key table at 0x15a1dc has the 1.82 layout. New record builder FUN_000d7c20 has the same ABI and six-byte CMP/IT/CMP prefix as 1.82 FUN_000d7b80. FUN_0001ab98 registers gtk_timeout_add(1000,0x1a245,app) before gtk_main; callback FUN_0001a244 has the same ABI, return/shutdown behavior and six-byte LDR/PUSH prefix as 1.82 FUN_0001a21c.

external_imports: Resolve libc, CTK/GTK and g_timeout_add exports through target module dynamic symbols.
lifecycle: apl_setting runs only while Player Settings is open; the payload is installed for each run. The submenu is a CTK window over the right area; while it is open the active key table is the payload's, Return restores the tile's table and destroys the window. A stock one-second GTK callback performs idempotent late-install repair without remote UI calls, changing focus or showing a hidden parent window.
